title: Egyptian Chicken Croquettes
description: A crispy and flavorful twist on traditional croquettes, filled with shredded chicken and Middle Eastern spices.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, crushed croquettes, Egyptian zesty seasoning, eggs, panko breadcrumbs, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the patties.
Bake the croquettes in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
